_about: Monkey's sound-effect kit (ElevenLabs SFX). takes = how many variations to keep; lufs = loudness target. Every prompt gets the suffix from generate_sfx.py.

pop.prompt: Small bright cartoon pop, like a bubble bursting

zPop.prompt: Tiny soft gentle bubble bloop, high pitched, very quiet and cute

tick.prompt: Tiny soft wooden tick, very short

sweat.prompt: Single cartoon water droplet plip, high and clean

boing.prompt: Springy cartoon boing, bouncy and comedic

startle.prompt: Cartoon startle: quick rising slide whistle then a bright ping

sparkle.prompt: Magical sparkle chime, quick ascending glittery xylophone notes, rewarding

whoosh.prompt: Fast small arm swing whoosh, cartoon swish

thump.prompt: Soft heavy cartoon body thump on grass, low and padded

chest_thump.prompt: Gorilla beating its chest: one deep hollow punchy thump

dust.prompt: Soft puff of dust, airy poof

flop.prompt: Heavy cartoon body flopping onto soft grass, thud with a springy bounce

slam.prompt: Huge cartoon ground slam: heavy boom, rocks cracking, pebbles raining down

shockwave.prompt: Short deep whoomp shockwave ring, cartoon power pulse

crack.prompt: Knuckles cracking, two quick pops, comedic

scratch.prompt: Quick scratching of thick fur with fingernails

rustle.prompt: Soft fur rustle and a light shuffle of feet on dry leaves

footstep.prompt: Single heavy soft padded footstep on a jungle floor

tap.prompt: Single impatient foot tap on wood, crisp

peel.prompt: Banana peel being pulled back in one quick strip

chomp.prompt: Juicy big bite of a banana, cartoon chomp

brrr.prompt: Wet dog shaking off water, fast flapping fur and droplets

ding.prompt: Bright cartoon idea ding, glass bell with a little shimmer

question.prompt: Short questioning cartoon sound, rising wobbly bend

ear_perk.prompt: Short bright friendly twinkle, tiny and alert

steam.prompt: Cartoon steam whistle hiss bursting out, short angry

heart_pop.prompt: Three quick ascending cheerful cartoon bubble pops

sad_trombone.prompt: Sad trombone wah wah wah waaah, short and comic

confetti.prompt: Confetti cannon pop with a party horn toot and paper flutter

check.prompt: Satisfying soft wooden ka-thunk checkbox click with a tiny sparkle

ui_click.prompt: Soft rounded wooden UI button click, very short

ui_open.prompt: Soft bouncy pop-up whoosh, a menu opening, light

ui_close.prompt: Soft quick closing swish, light and short

ui_error.prompt: Cartoon bonk on a coconut, short error sound

reward.prompt: Short triumphant cartoon jingle, xylophone and kazoo, joyful

snore.prompt: Big comedic cartoon snore: deep rumbling inhale then a high whistling exhale

dizzy_loop.prompt: Cartoon dizzy tweeting birds circling, seamless loop

ticktock_loop.prompt: Soft wooden tick-tock clock, steady, comedic, seamless loop

jungle_loop.prompt: Gentle daytime jungle ambience, distant birds and insects, calm, seamless loop
